pagination.text: LINEN / COMMUNITY PROGRAMME STUDIOA service schedule that stays connected.Working paper L-29-09 / 04 September 2029 / Illustrative USD amounts01 / Scope and fee summaryThis fictional studio helps a neighbourhood library plan a community programme. The schedule separates included work from an optional follow-up clinic. It is a demonstration, not a contract, invoice, tax calculation or payment request.SCOPE / The register contains ￼ service lines, of which ￼ are included. Included fees total ￼. Optional work is recorded separately at ￼ and is not added to that total.EFFORT / Included work carries ￼ estimated hours. The mean included fee is ￼ per included line; it is not an hourly rate and does not imply that the lines have equal effort.Each figure is a native inline formula reading the Base register. The wording, headings and page structure remain authored document content when a fee or status changes.Reading order / Summary · Working register · Phase allocation

02 / Working service registerDouble-click the native Base block, then expand it to edit. Correct the facilitation fee from 850 to 1000: the included total becomes 2650. Include the clinic only when you want its fee and hours counted.Fees and hours are independent recorded estimates. A blank fee is missing information, whereas zero explicitly records no fee. Neither changes the number of included lines unless their status changes.

03 / Phase allocation and reviewALLOCATION / Included discovery work contributes ￼, delivery work ￼, and handoff work ￼. These phases reconcile to the included total of ￼; optional records are excluded from every phase subtotal.Delivery represents ￼ of included fees. The current scope signal is: ￼. Changing the optional clinic to Included affects the delivery allocation as well as the summary on page one.REVIEW / An owner or scope-note edit adds context without changing the arithmetic. A view filter changes visible records, not the whole-table references. Editing a hidden discovery record must still update this allocation.BOUNDARIES / If every included fee is zero, a delivery share has no denominator. The native error is shown rather than replaced with 0%. Missing source bindings also remain visible errors until explicitly repaired.READING COPY / A display-text snapshot detaches the current results for reading. It does not save the separate Base, perform DOCX/PDF conversion or replace the live document.Prepared for discussion / No approval workflow, billing integration or backend connection.
